description: This source file contains SwiftUI view extensions and UI components for the onboarding process of the OpenClaw application on macOS. It defines various onboarding pages including welcome, connection setup, permissions, CLI installation, workspace configuration, onboarding chat, and final readiness screen. The code handles user interaction, remote gateway probing, permission requests, and dynamic UI updates related to onboarding the user onto the platform.
